test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.**

What __happened__ to your family if you continue to splurge money like this?
solution:
The correct answer is: **will happen**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace "**happened**" with **"will happen"** to make the sentence correct.
 
• The given sentence is a conditional sentence in the interrogative form.
 
• We use the **simple present tense in the if-clause** and **simple future tense in the main clause**—that is, the clause that expresses the likely outcome.
 
• Therefore, "**will happen**" should be used in the main clause.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 3**.

**Improved sentence:** *What **will happen__** to your family if you continue to splurge money like this? *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**happened**" is generally used in the simple past tense.
 
• "**is happening**" is generally used in the present continuous tense.
 
• "**has happened**" is generally used in the present perfect tense.
